gloss: to creak; to squeak; to grate

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {軋|きし}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to creak; to squeak; to grate
definitions.explanation: For something to make a creaking or squeaking sound due to friction, pressure, or wear. Commonly used for doors, floors, wheels, and joints.

definitions.gloss: to be strained; to have friction (in relationships)
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe tension or discord in relationships or organizations.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}が{軋|きし}む{音|おと}がした。
examples.english: The floor made a creaking sound.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}ると、{一段|いちだん}ごとに{軋|きし}んだ。
examples.english: When I climbed the old staircase, every step creaked.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}の{関係|かんけい}が{軋|きし}んでいる。
{両国|りょうこく}の{関係|かんけい}が{軋|きし}んでいる。
examples.english: Relations between the two countries are strained.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}の{対立|たいりつ}で、チーム{内|ない}の{関係|かんけい}が{軋|きし}み{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Due to conflicting opinions, relationships within the team began to show strain.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}).

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (-む type)
- {軋|きし}まない (negative)
- {軋|きし}みます (polite)
- {軋|きし}んで (te-form)
- {軋|きし}んだ (past)

ONOMATOPOEIC ORIGIN:
The word captures the きしきし sound of creaking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扉|とびら}が{軋|きし}む - a door creaks
- {床|ゆか}が{軋|きし}む - the floor creaks
- {歯|は}を{軋|きし}らせる - to grind one's teeth
- {関係|かんけい}が{軋|きし}む - relations become strained

RELATED WORDS:
- {軋|きし}み - creaking (noun)
- きしきし - onomatopoeia for creaking

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in descriptive writing and everyday conversation.
